'''Becca Westone''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Becca Westone attended the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] as a [[Journalist/Legends|journalism]] major. Upon graduation, she found work with a news agency which she found had pro-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] management. Westone wrote an in-depth and highly-specific exposé against them for [[Imperial HoloVision]]. The agency was quickly shut down, and she was offered a position within Imperial HoloVision. Westone accepted the offer, and soon became known as one of the agency's best investigative reporters.
